question: Why must the sacred teaching be withheld from those who revile Śiva and Kula Bhairava?
premises: The goddess is addressed regarding this restriction
inference: The teaching must not be given to revilers of Śiva or slanderers of Kula Bhairava.
plain_english: O Goddess, it must not be given to one who reviles Śiva or slanders Kula Bhairava.
